KBC Monday Night Ride

Kalamazoo, MI

Beginner friendly

KBC Monday Night Ride is a road group ride in Kalamazoo, MI. It meets every Monday, March 10–Oct 31; 6:00 pm (5:30 pm in March and October), starting at Texas Drive Park. Expect about 15–30 miles, up to eight groups, 12–13 mph through 19–21 mph.

About the KBC Monday Night Ride group ride

The club's main weeknight ride, with up to eight pace groups from a 12–13 mph no-drop learner ride to a fast Lawton loop. Pick your group in the parking lot. Helmets required.
